notes: Body-only digital cinema camera; official model number AU-V35LT1G. Data pulled from Panasonic's own VariCam LT Operating Guide specification pages (pro-av.panasonic.net manual, "Video output" / "Audio input-output" / "Other input-output" tables, cross-checked against the panel-diagram page chapter02_01_02.htm), which give exact connector pin-counts/voltages beyond what the marketing spec page (pro-av.panasonic.net/en/cinema_camera_varicam_eva/products/varicam_lt/spec/index.html) lists. No HDMI is fitted — SDI OUT 1/2 (BNC, dual-rate HD 1.5G/3G-SDI) are the only monitor outs, and the EVF gets its own VF SDI BNC out. DC IN / DC OUT / DC OUT-RS are Hirose-brand 4-pin circular connectors (DC IN explicitly documented as Hirose HA16RA-4P); mapped to the closest catalog id "xlr4-dc" since Hirose isn't a listed connector type — same 4-pin DC-power convention as XLR4-DC but not a locking XLR shell. Two proprietary multi-pin accessory terminals were omitted (no catalog connector fits): <LENS/GRIP> (12-pin, lens cable / AU-VGRP1G grip module) and <CONTROL PANEL> (20-pin, external control-panel accessory). The built-in 20mm round speaker and the 8-pin EF lens-mount electrical contacts were also omitted as neither is a general-purpose I/O jack.

ports.name: VF SDI
ports.note: Feeds the removable EVF, not a general-purpose monitor output.

ports.name: GENLOCK IN
ports.note: Panasonic specifies electrical compatibility as HD(1.5G)/3G-SDI reference; grade inferred from that spec, not an explicit SDI-grade label.

ports.name: TC IN/OUT
ports.note: Single BNC jack, menu-switchable between timecode input and output.

ports.name: INPUT 1/2
ports.note: Single 5-pin XLR carries both mic/line channels 1 and 2 (stereo).

ports.name: USB HOST
ports.note: Rated 5V/0.5A; intended for Panasonic AJ-WM30/AJ-WM50 wireless module.

ports.name: DC IN
ports.note: Hirose HA16RA-4P 4-pin connector (closest catalog match). DC 12V, 11.0-17.0V range; main camera power input.

ports.name: DC OUT/RS
ports.note: 4-pin Hirose-type connector; supplies DC 12V/1A max to accessories (e.g. on-camera light) and doubles as REC start/stop trigger input.

ports.name: DC OUT
ports.note: 4-pin Hirose-type connector dedicated to powering the viewfinder, DC 12V/1A max.
